He said: I saw ʿUthmān, while he was at al-Maqāʿid, call for ablution water, and rinse his mouth three times, sniff water into his nose three times, wash his face three times and his forearms three times each, wipe his head three times, and wash his feet. Then he said: Whoever loves to look at the ablution of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, this is the ablution of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-437: Sulaymān ibn Ḥarb and ʿAffān narrated to us – the meaning – both said: Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Abū Umāmah ibn Sahl, he said: We were with ʿUthmān while he was besieged in the house, and he entered an entrance where, when he entered it, whoever was on the paved area could hear his words. He said: He entered that entrance and came out to us and said: They threatened me with killing just now. He said: We said: Allah will suffice you against them, O Commander of the Believers. He said: And for what would they kill me? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The blood of a Muslim man is not lawful except for one of three: a man who disbelieved after his Islam, or committed zinā after being muḥṣan, or killed a person and is killed for it.” By Allah, I have not wished to have a substitute for my religion since Allah guided me, nor have I committed zinā in Jāhiliyyah or Islam ever, nor have I killed a person; so for what would they kill me?
items.ma-438: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar al-Qawārīrī narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, Abū Umāmah ibn Sahl ibn Ḥunayf narrated to us, he said: I was with ʿUthmān in the house while he was besieged, and he said: We used to enter an entrance … then he mentioned the hadith like it, and he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say … then he mentioned the hadith like it, or similar.
items.ma-439:
ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, al-Qāsim – meaning Ibn al-Faḍl – narrated to us, ʿAmr ibn Murrah narrated to us, from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd, he said: ʿUthmān called some people from the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, among them ʿAmmār ibn Yāsir, and said: I am going to ask you, and I would like you to be truthful with me: I adjure you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to give preference to Quraysh over the rest of the people, and give preference to Banū Hāshim over the rest of Quraysh? The people fell silent, and ʿUthmān said: If I held the keys of Paradise in my hand, I would give them to Banū Umayyah until they entered, down to the last of them.
Then he sent for Ṭalḥah and al-Zubayr, and ʿUthmān said: Shall I not narrate to you both about him – meaning ʿAmmār? I set out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, taking me by the hand, walking in the Baṭḥāʾ, until he came upon his father and his mother, and ʿalayhi, they were being tortured. ʿAmmār's father said: O Messenger of Allah, forever like this? The Prophet ﷺ said to him: “Be patient.” Then he said: “O Allah, forgive the family of Yāsir, and I have done so.”
items.ma-440: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥurayth ibn al-Sāʾib narrated to us, he said: I heard al-Ḥasan say: Ḥumrān narrated to me, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Everything besides the shade of a house, a jilf of bread, a garment that covers his ʿawrah, and water – whatever is in excess of this, the son of Ādam has no right (*) in it.”
items.ma-441: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bakr narrated to us, Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl narrated to us, from a shaykh of Thaqīf whom Ḥumayd mentioned with praise for his righteousness; he mentioned that his paternal uncle informed him: that he saw ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān sit at the second door of the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and call for a shoulder of meat and gnaw it, then stand and pray without performing ablution. Then he said: I sat in the seat of the Prophet ﷺ, and I ate what the Prophet ﷺ ate, and I did what the Prophet ﷺ did.
items.ma-442: Abū Saʿīd, the mawlā of Banū Hāshim, narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Zuhrah ibn Maʿbad narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of ʿUthmān, that he narrated to him, he said: I heard ʿUthmān say at Minā: O people, I am narrating to you a hadith that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; I heard him say: “Ribāṭ for a day in the path of Allah is better than a thousand days elsewhere; so let a man perform ribāṭ however he wishes.” Have I conveyed it? They said: Yes. He said: O Allah, bear witness.
items.ma-443: Abū Saʿīd – meaning the mawlā of Banū Hāshim – narrated to us, ʿIkrimah ibn Ibrāhīm al-Bāhilī narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Dhubāb narrated to us, from his father: that ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān prayed four rakʿahs at Minā, and the people objected to it. He said: O people, I have taken a family in Makkah since I arrived, and I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever takes a family in a town, let him pray the prayer of the resident.”
items.ma-444: Abū Saʿīd, the mawlā of Banū Hāshim, narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Mūsā ibn Wardān narrated to us, he said: I heard Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab say: I heard ʿUthmān giving a khuṭbah from the minbar, saying: I used to buy dates from a clan of the Jews called Banū Qaynuqāʿ, and I would sell them at a profit. That reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said: “O ʿUthmān, when you buy, take by measure; and when you sell, measure out.”
items.ma-445: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Mūsā ibn Wardān narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, then he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-446: ʿUbayd ibn Abī Qurrah narrated to us, Ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from his father, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever says: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on the earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing – nothing will harm him.”
items.ma-447: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb al-Khaffāf narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Muslim ibn Yasār, from Ḥumrān ibn Abān, that ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Indeed I know a word which no servant says truthfully from his heart except that he is made forbidden to the Fire.” ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said to him: Shall I tell you what it is? It is the word of sincerity, which Allah ﵎ made binding upon Muḥammad ﷺ and his Companions, and it is the word of taqwā which the Prophet of Allah ﷺ urged his uncle Abū Ṭālib to say at death: the testimony that there is no deity except Allah.
items.ma-448: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to me, my father narrated to me, al-Ḥusayn – meaning al-Muʿallim – narrated to us, from Yaḥyā – meaning Ibn Abī Kathīr – Abū Salamah informed me that ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yasār informed him that Zayd ibn Khālid al-Juhanī informed him: that he asked ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, I said: What if a man has relations with his wife and does not ejaculate? ʿUthmān said: He performs ablution as he performs ablution for the prayer, and washes his private part. And ʿUthmān said: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then I asked about that ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, al-Zubayr ibn al-ʿAwwām, Ṭalḥah ibn ʿUbayd Allāh and Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, and they commanded him with that.
items.ma-449: ʿUbayd ibn Abī Qurrah narrated to us, he said: I heard Mālik ibn Anas say: {We raise in degrees whom We will} [al-Anʿām: 83], he said: By knowledge. I said: Who narrated that to you? He said: Zayd ibn Aslam claimed that.
items.ma-450: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr narrated to us, Masarrah ibn Maʿbad narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Abī Kabshah, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah, I prayed and did not know whether I had made it even or odd. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Beware lest Shayṭān toy with you in your prayer. Whoever among you prays and does not know whether he made it even or odd, let him prostrate two prostrations, for they are the completion of his prayer.”
items.ma-451: Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn and Ziyād ibn Ayyūb narrated to us, both said: Sawwār Abū ʿUmārah al-Ramlī narrated to us, from Masarrah ibn Maʿbad, he said: Yazīd ibn Abī Kabshah led us in the ʿAṣr prayer, and after his prayer he turned to us and said: I prayed with Marwān ibn al-Ḥakam, and he prostrated like these two prostrations, then turned to us and informed us that he had prayed with ʿUthmān, and narrated from the Prophet ﷺ … then he mentioned the like of it, similar to it.
items.ma-452: Isḥāq ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, he said: I heard Mughīrah ibn Muslim Abū Salamah mention, from Maṭar, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that ʿUthmān looked out upon his companions while he was besieged, and said: For what do you kill me? For I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The blood of a Muslim man is not lawful except for one of three: a man who committed zinā after being muḥṣan, upon him is rajm; or who killed deliberately, upon him is retaliation; or who apostatized after his Islam, upon him is death.” By Allah, I have not committed zinā in Jāhiliyyah or Islam, nor have I killed anyone such that I should be retaliated against for him, nor have I apostatized since I became Muslim. I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah, and that Muḥammad is His servant and His Messenger.
items.ma-453: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū Qabīl narrated to us, he said: I heard Mālik ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Zabādī narrating from Abū Dharr: that he came asking permission to see ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, and he permitted him, while his staff was in his hand. ʿUthmān said: O Kaʿb, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān has died and left wealth; what do you think of it? He said: If he was fulfilling the right of Allah in it, there is no harm upon him. Abū Dharr raised his staff and struck Kaʿb, and said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “I would not like, if this mountain were gold for me, that I spend it and have it accepted from me, and leave behind me six ūqiyahs of it.” I adjure you by Allah, O ʿUthmān, did you hear it – three times? He said: Yes.
items.ma-454: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn narrated to me, Hishām ibn Yūsuf narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buḥayr al-Qāṣṣ narrated to me, from Hāniʾ, the mawlā of ʿUthmān, he said: When ʿUthmān stood at a grave he would weep until he wet his beard. It was said to him: You mention Paradise and the Fire and do not weep, yet you weep at this? He said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The grave is the first of the stations of the Hereafter; if one is saved from it, then what comes after it is easier than it, and if one is not saved from it, then what comes after it is more severe than it.” He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I have never seen a sight but that the grave is more dreadful than it.”
items.ma-455: Zakariyyā ibn ʿAdī narrated to us, ʿAlī ibn Mushir narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from Marwān – and I do not suppose he is suspected against us – he said: ʿUthmān was afflicted with a nosebleed in the Year of the Nosebleed, until he stayed back from Ḥajj and made a bequest. A man of Quraysh entered upon him and said: Appoint a successor. He said: And have they said it? He said: Yes. He said: Who is he? He said: and he was silent. He said: Then another man entered upon him and said to him what the first had said, and he replied to him similarly. ʿUthmān said: They said: al-Zubayr? He said: Yes. He said: By Him in Whose Yad is my soul, he was indeed the best of them, as far as I know, and the most beloved of them to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-456: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Suwayd narrated it to us, ʿAlī ibn Mushir narrated to us, with his chain, like it.
items.ma-457: Zakariyyā ibn Abī Zakariyyā narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Sulaym narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn Umayyah narrated to us, from ʿImrān ibn Mannāḥ, he said: Abān ibn ʿUthmān saw a funeral and stood for it, and said: ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān saw a funeral and stood for it, then narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a funeral and stood for it.
items.ma-458: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Salamah, that ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yasār informed him, from Zayd ibn Khālid al-Juhanī, that he informed him: that he asked ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: I said: What if a man has relations with his wife and does not ejaculate? ʿUthmān said: He performs ablution as for the prayer, and washes his private part. He said: And ʿUthmān said: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then I asked about that ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, al-Zubayr, Ṭalḥah and Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, and they commanded him with that.
items.ma-459: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm ibn al-Ḥārith al-Taymī, he said: Muʿādh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed me that Ḥumrān ibn Abān informed him, he said: I came to ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān while he was sitting at al-Maqāʿid, and he performed ablution and did the ablution well. Then he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in this very seat perform ablution and do the ablution well, then he said: And he said: “Whoever performs ablution like this ablution of mine, then comes to the mosque and prays two rakʿahs in it, what preceded of his sin is forgiven him.” And he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “And do not be deluded.”
items.ma-460: ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn Ḥafṣ ibn ʿUmar al-Taymī narrated to us, he said: I heard my father say: I heard my uncle ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar ibn Mūsā say: I was with Sulaymān ibn ʿAlī when an old man of Quraysh entered. Sulaymān said: Look to the shaykh and seat him in a good seat, for Quraysh have a right. I said: O commander, shall I not narrate to you a hadith that reached me from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said: Yes. I said to him: It reached me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever humiliates Quraysh, Allah humiliates him.” He said: Subḥān Allāh, how good this is! Who narrated this to you? I said: Rabīʿah ibn Abī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated it to me, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: My father said to me: O my son, if you are given any authority over the people, honor Quraysh, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever humiliates Quraysh, Allah humiliates him.”
items.ma-461: Ismāʿīl ibn Abān al-Warrāq narrated to us, Yaʿqūb narrated to us, from Jaʿfar ibn Abī al-Mughīrah, from Ibn Abzā, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr said to him when he was besieged: I have swift riding-camels that I have prepared for you; would you like to move to Makkah, so that whoever wishes to come to you may come to you? He said: No. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “A ram of Quraysh, whose name is ʿAbd Allāh, will commit ilḥād in Makkah; upon him will be like half the burdens of the people.”
items.ma-462: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bakr and Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, both said: Saʿīd narrated to us, from Maṭar and Yaʿlā ibn Ḥakīm, from Nāfiʿ, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The muḥrim does not marry, nor give in marriage, nor propose.”
items.ma-463: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Kahmas narrated to us, Muṣʿab ibn Thābit ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr narrated to us, he said: ʿUthmān said while giving a khuṭbah on his minbar: I am going to narrate to you a hadith that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; nothing prevented me from narrating it to you except stinginess toward you. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Guarding for a night in the path of Allah is better than a thousand nights whose night is spent in prayer and whose day is spent in fasting.”
items.ma-464: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Khālid, from Abū Bishr al-ʿAnbarī, from Ḥumrān ibn Abān, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever dies knowing that there is no deity except Allah will enter Paradise.”
items.ma-465: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wārith narrated to us, Ayyūb ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Nubayh ibn Wahb narrated to me: that ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Maʿmar's eye became inflamed while he was a muḥrim, and he wanted to apply kohl to it, but Abān ibn ʿUthmān forbade him and commanded him to bandage it with aloe, and claimed that ʿUthmān narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he did that.
items.ma-466: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wārith narrated to us, Ayyūb ibn Mūsā narrated to us, from Nubayh ibn Wahb: that ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh wanted to give his son in marriage while he was a muḥrim, and Abān forbade him, and claimed that ʿUthmān narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: “The muḥrim does not marry, nor give in marriage.”
items.ma-467: ʿAffān narrated to us, Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim narrated to us, he said: I heard Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Yaʿqūb narrating from Rabāḥ, he said: My people married me to a slave-woman of theirs, a Roman, and she bore me a black boy. A Roman slave called Yūḥannas became attached to her and began speaking to her in the Roman tongue, and she became pregnant – and she had already borne me a black boy like me – and she brought a boy as though he were a lizard of the lizards. I said to her: What is this? She said: He is Yūḥannas's. I asked Yūḥannas and he confessed. So I went to ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān and mentioned that to him, and he sent for the two of them and questioned them, then said: I will judge between you with the judgment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: “The child belongs to the firāsh, and for the adulterer is the Stone.” So he attached him to me. He said: and he flogged the two of them, and after that she bore me a black boy.
items.ma-468: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Abū Umāmah ibn Sahl, he said: I was with ʿUthmān in the house while he was besieged. He said: And we used to enter an entrance where, when we entered it, we could hear the words of those on the paved area. He said: ʿUthmān entered one day for a need, and came out to us with his color drained, and said: They were threatening me with killing just now. He said: We said: Allah will suffice you against them, O Commander of the Believers. He said: And for what would they kill me? For I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The blood of a Muslim man is not lawful except in one of three: a man who disbelieved after his Islam, or committed zinā after being muḥṣan, or killed a soul other than for a soul.” By Allah, I have never committed zinā in Jāhiliyyah or Islam, nor have I wished for a substitute for my religion since Allah ﷿ guided me, nor have I killed a soul; so for what would they kill me?
items.ma-469:
Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us (ḥ) and Surayj and Ḥusayn, both said: Ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀmir ibn Saʿd – Ḥusayn said: Ibn Abī Waqqāṣ – he said: I heard ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān say: What keeps me from narrating from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is not that I am not the most retentive of his Companions of what he said; rather, I bear witness that I heard him say: “Whoever says about me what I did not say, let him take his seat in the Fire.”
And Ḥusayn said: the most retentive of his Companions from him.
items.ma-470: Hāshim narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, Zuhrah ibn Maʿbad al-Qurashī narrated to me, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: I heard ʿUthmān say from the minbar: O people, I concealed from you a hadith that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, out of dislike that you would disperse from around me; then it occurred to me to narrate it to you, so that a man may choose for himself what appears best to him. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Ribāṭ for a day in the path of Allah is better than a thousand days in any other of the stations.”
items.ma-471: Hāshim narrated to us, Abū Jaʿfar al-Rāzī narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn ʿUmar, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Kaysān, from a man, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no Muslim who goes out from his house, intending a journey or otherwise, and says as he goes out: In the name of Allah, I believe in Allah, I hold fast to Allah, I put my trust in Allah, there is no might and no power except with Allah – except that he is provided with the good of that going-out, and the evil of that going-out is turned away from him.”
items.ma-472: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr al-Muqaddamī narrated to me, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from al-Ḥajjāj, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿUthmān, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution: he washed his face three times and his hands three times, wiped his head, and washed his feet, washing them thoroughly.
items.ma-473: Hāshim narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: Abū Ṣakhrah Jāmiʿ ibn Shaddād informed me, he said: I heard Ḥumrān ibn Abān narrating to Abū Burdah in the mosque of al-Baṣrah, while I was standing with him, that he heard ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān narrating from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Whoever completes the ablution as Allah ﷿ commanded him, then the five prayers are kaffārāt for what is between them.”
items.ma-474: Surayj narrated to us, Ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from his father, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, he said: I heard ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever says at the beginning of his day, or at the beginning of his night: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on the earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing – three times – nothing will harm him on that day, or on that night.”
items.ma-475: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Abū Sinān informed us, from Yazīd ibn Mawhab: that ʿUthmān said to Ibn ʿUmar: Judge between the people. He said: I will not judge between two, nor lead two men. Did you not hear the Prophet ﷺ say: “Whoever seeks refuge with Allah has sought refuge with One who gives refuge”? ʿUthmān said: Indeed. He said: Then I seek refuge with Allah from your appointing me. So he excused him, and said: Do not tell anyone of this.
items.ma-476: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Ziyād narrated to us, from ʿUthmān ibn Ḥakīm, Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir narrated to us, from Ḥumrān, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever performs ablution and does the ablution well, his sins come out of his body, until they come out from beneath his fingernails.”
items.ma-477: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Suwayd ibn Saʿīd narrated it to us in the year twenty-six, Rishdīn ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Zuhrah ibn Maʿbad, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of ʿUthmān, that ʿUthmān said: O people, go early, for I am going early. So the people went early. Then he said: O people, I am going to narrate to you a hadith that I have not spoken of from the time I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until this day of mine. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed ribāṭ for a day in the path of Allah is better than a thousand days elsewhere; so let a man perform ribāṭ wherever he wishes.” Have I conveyed it to you? They said: Yes. He said: O Allah, bear witness.
items.ma-478: Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm al-Taymī, Shaqīq ibn Salamah narrated to me, from Ḥumrān, he said: ʿUthmān was sitting at al-Maqāʿid, and he called for ablution water and performed ablution, then said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution in this seat of mine, then he said: “Whoever performs ablution like this ablution of mine, then stands and prays two rakʿahs, what preceded of his sin is forgiven him.” And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not be deluded.”
items.ma-479: Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, Arṭāh – meaning Ibn al-Mundhir – narrated to us, Abū ʿAwn al-Anṣārī informed me that ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān said to Ibn Masʿūd: Will you desist from what has reached me about you? He offered some excuse, and ʿUthmān said: Woe to you, I have heard and memorized, and it is not as you heard: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A commander will be killed and a usurper will leap forward.” And I am the one who will be killed, and it is not ʿUmar; ʿUmar was killed by one man alone, whereas they will gather against me.
items.ma-480: Bishr ibn Shuʿayb narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from al-Zuhrī, ʿUrwah ibn al-Zubayr narrated to me that ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAdī ibn al-Khiyār informed him that ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān said to him: Son of my brother, did you reach the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said: I said to him: No, but there reached me of his knowledge and certainty what reaches the virgin in her seclusion. He said: Then he made the testimony of faith, and said: Now then, indeed Allah ﷿ sent Muḥammad ﷺ with the truth; I was among those who responded to Allah and His Messenger, and believed in what Muḥammad ﷺ was sent with. Then I emigrated the two emigrations, as I have said, and I gained the in-law relationship of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. By Allah, I did not disobey him nor deceive him, until Allah ﷿ took him.
items.ma-481:
ʿAlī ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, al-Walīd ibn Muslim narrated to us, he said: And al-Awzāʿī informed me, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Marwān, that he narrated to him, from al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah: that he entered upon ʿUthmān while he was besieged, and said: You are the imām of the general public, and what you see has befallen you, and I put before you three options; choose one of them: either you go out and fight them, for you have numbers and strength, and you are in the right and they are in falsehood; or we breach for you a door other than the one they are at, and you mount your riding-camels and join Makkah, for they will not make you lawful while you are there; or you join al-Shām, for they are the people of al-Shām, and among them is Muʿāwiyah.
ʿUthmān said: As for my going out and fighting, I will not be the first to succeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his ummah by shedding blood. As for my going out to Makkah, they will not make me lawful there, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “A man of Quraysh will commit ilḥād in Makkah; upon him will be half the punishment of the world,” so I will not be he. And as for my joining al-Shām, they are the people of al-Shām, and among them is Muʿāwiyah; I will not leave the abode of my hijrah and the neighborhood of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-482: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated it to us, from Ibn al-Mubārak, then he mentioned the hadith and said: He commits ilḥād.
items.ma-483: Ḥajjāj and Yūnus narrated to us, both said: Layth narrated to us. Ḥajjāj said: Yazīd ibn Abī Ḥabīb narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Salamah and Nāfiʿ ibn Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim, from Muʿādh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Taymī, from Ḥumrān, the mawlā of ʿUthmān, from ʿUthmān, that he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever performs ablution and completes the ablution, then walks to an obligatory prayer and prays it, his sin is forgiven him.”
items.ma-485: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Yūnus, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Farrūkh, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Allah admitted into Paradise a man who was easy-going: as a payer and as a collector, as a seller and as a buyer.”
items.ma-486: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm ibn al-Muhājir, from ʿIkrimah ibn Khālid, a man of the people of al-Madīnah narrated to me: that the mu'adhdhin gave the adhān for the ʿaṣr prayer, and ʿUthmān called for water for purification and purified himself. Then he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever purifies himself as he was commanded, and prays as he was commanded, his sins are expiated.” And he called four of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to bear witness to that, and they testified to it for him from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-487: Ibn al-Ashjaʿī narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Sālim Abū al-Naḍr, from Busr ibn Saʿīd, he said: ʿUthmān came to al-Maqāʿid and called for ablution water, and rinsed his mouth and sniffed water into his nose, then washed his face three times and his hands three times each, then wiped his head and his feet three times each. Then he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution like this; O you people, is it so? They said: Yes – to a group of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who were with him.
items.ma-488: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, Sālim Abū al-Naḍr narrated to me, from Busr ibn Saʿīd, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān: that he called for water and performed ablution at al-Maqāʿid, washing three times each. Then he said to the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Did you see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do this? They said: Yes. My father said: This is al-ʿAdanī; he was in Makkah the mustamlī of Ibn ʿUyaynah.
items.ma-489: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Ibn Isḥāq, Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm ibn al-Ḥārith al-Taymī narrated to me, from Muʿādh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Taymī, from Ḥumrān ibn Abān, the mawlā of ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: I saw ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān call for ablution water while he was at the door of the mosque. He washed his hands, then rinsed his mouth, sniffed water into his nose and blew it out, then washed his face three times, then washed his hands to the elbows three times, then wiped his head, passing his hands over the outer part of his ears, then passing them over his beard, then washed his feet to the ankles three times. Then he stood and prayed two rakʿahs. Then he said: I performed ablution for you as I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution, then I prayed two rakʿahs as I saw him pray. He said: Then he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, when he had finished his two rakʿahs: “Whoever performs ablution as I have performed ablution, then prays two rakʿahs in which he does not speak to himself, what is between them and his prayer of yesterday is forgiven him.”
items.ma-490: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Shaqīq, he said: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf met al-Walīd ibn ʿUqbah, and al-Walīd said to him: Why do I see that you have shunned the Commander of the Believers ʿUthmān? ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said to him: Inform him that I did not flee on the day of ʿAynayn – ʿĀṣim said: he means the day of Uḥud – and I did not stay behind on the day of Badr, and I did not abandon the Sunnah of ʿUmar. He said: So he went and told ʿUthmān that. He said: ʿUthmān said: As for his saying that I did not flee on the day of ʿAynayn, how can he reproach me with a sin that Allah has pardoned? For He said: {Indeed, those of you who turned back on the day the two armies met – it was only Shayṭān who caused them to slip, through some of what they had earned; and Allah has already pardoned them} [Āl ʿImrān: 155]. And as for his saying that I stayed behind on the day of Badr, I was tending Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, until she died, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ allotted me my share, and whoever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ allots his share has been present. And as for his saying that I did not abandon the Sunnah of ʿUmar, I cannot bear it, nor can he; so go to him and tell him that.
items.ma-491: Isḥāq ibn Yūsuf narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Sahl – meaning ʿUthmān ibn Ḥakīm – ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAmrah narrated to us, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever prays ʿishāʾ in congregation, it is like standing in prayer for half a night; and whoever prays ʿishāʾ and fajr in congregation, it is like standing in prayer for a night.”
items.ma-492: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, he said: Ibn Maʿmar wanted to give his son in marriage to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr, and he sent me to Abān ibn ʿUthmān, who was the commander of the Ḥajj season. I came to him and said to him: Your brother wants to give his son in marriage, and he wants you to witness that. He said: Do I not see him as a coarse Iraqi? The muḥrim neither marries nor gives in marriage. Then he narrated from ʿUthmān the like of it, attributing it to the Prophet.
items.ma-493: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from Ḥumrān, the mawlā of ʿUthmān: that ʿUthmān performed ablution at al-Maqāʿid, washing three times each, and said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever performs ablution like this ablution of mine, then stands to the prayer, his sins fall away” – meaning from his face, his hands, his feet and his head.
items.ma-494: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Ayyūb ibn Mūsā, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, he said: ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Maʿmar complained of his eyes, and sent to Abān ibn ʿUthmān – Sufyān said: and he was a commander – asking what he should do with them. He said: He said: Bandage them with aloe, for I heard ʿUthmān narrate that from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-495: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, al-Ḥakam ibn Mūsā Abū Ṣāliḥ narrated to me, Saʿīd ibn Maslamah narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Umayyah, from Mūsā ibn ʿImrān ibn Mannāḥ, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān: that he saw a funeral approaching, and when he saw it he stood, and said: I saw ʿUthmān do that, and he informed me that he saw the Prophet ﷺ do it.
items.ma-496: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb ibn Mūsā, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUthmān, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The muḥrim neither marries nor proposes.”
items.ma-497: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb ibn Mūsā ibn ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, a man of the Ḥajabah, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, that he narrated from ʿUthmān: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted a concession, or said, regarding the muḥrim when his eye ails, that he bandage it with aloe.
items.ma-498: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Khālid al-Ḥadhdhāʾ, from al-Walīd Abū Bishr, from Ḥumrān, from ʿUthmān, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever dies knowing that there is no deity except Allah will enter Paradise.”
items.ma-499:
Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, ʿAwf ibn Abī Jamīlah narrated to us, Yazīd al-Fārisī narrated to me, Ibn ʿAbbās narrated to us, he said: I said to ʿUthmān: What induced you to take al-Anfāl, which is of the mathānī, and Barāʾah, which is of the miʾīn, and join them, and not write between them the line: In the name of Allah, al-Raḥmān, al-Raḥīm, and place them among the seven long ones? What induced you to that?
He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would have periods of time pass while surahs with a number of verses were being revealed to him. When something was revealed to him he would call one of those who wrote for him and say: “Put these in the surah in which such-and-such is mentioned.” And when verses were revealed to him he said: “Put these verses in the surah in which such-and-such is mentioned.” And when a verse was revealed to him he said: “Put this verse in the surah in which such-and-such is mentioned.” Al-Anfāl was among the first of what was revealed in al-Madīnah, and Barāʾah was among the last of what was revealed of the Qurʾān. Its story resembled its story, so we thought that it was part of it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was taken without having made clear to us that it was part of it. It was for that reason that I joined them, and did not write between them a line: In the name of Allah, al-Raḥmān, al-Raḥīm, and I placed them among the seven long ones.
items.ma-500: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Sufyān and Shuʿbah, from ʿAlqamah ibn Marthad, from Saʿd ibn ʿUbaydah, from Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿUthmān, from the Prophet ﷺ. Sufyān said: “The most excellent of you,” and Shuʿbah said: “The best of you is the one who learns the Qurʾān and teaches it.”
items.ma-501: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid, he said: Qays said: Abū Sahlah narrated to me: that ʿUthmān said on the Day of the House, when he was besieged: Indeed the Prophet ﷺ entrusted me with a charge, and I am patient upon it. Qays said: They used to think that it meant that day.
items.ma-502: Yazīd narrated to us, Mahdī ibn Maymūn informed us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Yaʿqūb, from al-Ḥasan ibn Saʿd, he said: Rabāḥ narrated to me, he said: My master married me to a Roman slave-girl, and I had relations with her and she bore me a black boy like me, and I named him ʿAbd Allāh. Then I had relations with her and she bore me a black boy like me, and I named him ʿUbayd Allāh. Then a Roman slave-boy took notice of me – he said: I think he said: belonging to my people, a Roman – called Yūḥannas, and he spoke to her in his tongue – meaning in Roman – and had relations with her, and she bore him a red boy as though he were a lizard of the lizards. I said to her: What is this? She said: This is from Yūḥannas. He said: So we took the matter up to ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, and both of them confessed. ʿUthmān said: If you wish, I will judge between you with the judgment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ judged that the child belongs to the firāsh. He said: I think he said: and he flogged the two of them.
items.ma-503: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Jāmiʿ ibn Shaddād, he said: I heard Ḥumrān ibn Abān narrating to Abū Burdah in the mosque that he heard ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān narrating from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Whoever completes the ablution as Allah commanded him, then the obligatory prayers are kaffārāt for what is between them.”
items.ma-504: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, he said: I heard ʿAbbād ibn Zāhir Abū Rawāʿ say: I heard ʿUthmān giving a khuṭbah, and he said: By Allah, we accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on journey and at home. He would visit our sick, follow our funerals, fight with us, and share with us in little and in much. Yet some people are teaching me about him, when perhaps not one of them ever saw him.
items.ma-505: Al-Walīd ibn Muslim narrated to us, Shuʿayb Abū Shaybah narrated to me, he said: I heard ʿAṭāʾ al-Khurāsānī say: I heard Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab say: I saw ʿUthmān sitting at al-Maqāʿid, and he called for food that fire had touched and ate it, then stood to the prayer and prayed. Then ʿUthmān said: I sat in the seat of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I ate the food of the Messenger of Allah, and I prayed the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-506: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk ibn Makhlad narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from Maḥmūd ibn Labīd: that ʿUthmān wanted to rebuild the mosque of al-Madīnah, and the people disliked that and preferred to leave it in its form. ʿUthmān said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah builds for him a house in Paradise like it.”
items.ma-507: ʿAbd al-Kabīr ibn ʿAbd al-Majīd Abū Bakr al-Ḥanafī narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, from his father, from Maḥmūd ibn Labīd, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān; meaning, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever deliberately lies about me, let him take a house in the Fire.”
items.ma-508: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Yūnus narrated to us, ʿAṭāʾ ibn Farrūkh, the mawlā of the Qurashīs, narrated to us, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Allah admitted into Paradise a man who was easy-going: as a buyer, as a seller, as a payer and as a collector.”
items.ma-509: Sulaymān ibn Ḥarb narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from Abū Umāmah ibn Sahl ibn Ḥunayf, he said: We were with ʿUthmān while he was besieged in the house. He said: And for what do they kill me? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The blood of a Muslim man is not lawful except for one of three: a man who disbelieved after his Islam, or committed zinā after being muḥṣan, or killed a soul and is killed for it.”
items.ma-510:
ʿUthmān ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Khālid ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Qāriẓ, from Abū ʿUbayd, the mawlā of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Azhar, he said: I saw ʿAlī and ʿUthmān praying on the day of al-Fiṭr and al-Aḍḥā, then turning away, reminding the people. He said: And I heard them both say: Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade fasting on these two days.
He said: And I heard ʿAlī say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that anything of your nusuk should remain with you after three.
items.ma-511:
Bahz narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, Ḥuṣayn narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Jāwān, he said: Al-Aḥnaf said: We set out as pilgrims and passed by al-Madīnah. While we were in our lodging, a messenger came to us and said: The people are alarmed in the mosque. So my companion and I went, and the people were gathered around a group in the mosque. He said: I made my way through them until I stood over them, and there were ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, al-Zubayr, Ṭalḥah and Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ. He said: It was not long before ʿUthmān came walking, and he said: Is ʿAlī here? They said: Yes. He said: Is al-Zubayr here? They said: Yes. He said: Is Ṭalḥah here? They said: Yes. He said: Is Saʿd here? They said: Yes.
He said: I adjure you by Allah, besides whom there is no deity, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever buys the mirbad of Banū so-and-so, Allah will forgive him”? So I bought it, and came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: I have bought it. He said: “Make it part of our mosque, and its reward is yours”? They said: Yes.
He said: I adjure you by Allah, besides whom there is no deity, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Who will buy the well of Rūmah?” and I bought it for such-and-such, and came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: I have bought it – meaning the well of Rūmah – and he said: “Make it a drinking-place for the Muslims, and its reward is yours”? They said: Yes. He said: I adjure you by Allah, besides whom there is no deity, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ looked at the faces of the people on the day of Jaysh al-ʿUsrah and said: “Whoever equips these, Allah will forgive him,” and I equipped them, until they lacked neither halter nor hobbling-rope? They said: O Allah, yes. He said: O Allah, bear witness; O Allah, bear witness; O Allah, bear witness. Then he left.
items.ma-513: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Muqriʾ narrated to us, Ḥaywah narrated to us, Abū ʿAqīl informed us that he heard al-Ḥārith, the mawlā of ʿUthmān, say: ʿUthmān sat one day and we sat with him, and the mu'adhdhin came to him. He called for water in a vessel – I think it would hold a mudd – and performed ablution. Then he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution like this ablution of mine, then he said: “Whoever performs ablution like this ablution of mine, then stands and prays the Ẓuhr prayer, what is between it and Ṣubḥ is forgiven him; then he prays ʿAṣr, and what is between it and the Ẓuhr prayer is forgiven him; then he prays Maghrib, and what is between it and the ʿAṣr prayer is forgiven him; then he prays ʿIshāʾ, and what is between it and the Maghrib prayer is forgiven him; then perhaps he spends his night tossing about; then if he stands and performs ablution and prays Ṣubḥ, what is between it and the ʿIshāʾ prayer is forgiven him. And they are the good deeds that take away the evil deeds.” They said: These are the good deeds; what are the lasting ones, O ʿUthmān? He said: They are: There is no deity except Allah; Subḥān Allāh; all praise is for Allah; Allah is the Greatest; and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
items.ma-514:
Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, ʿUqayl narrated to me, from Ibn Shihāb, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ, that Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ informed him that ʿĀʾishah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, and ʿUthmān narrated to him: that Abū Bakr asked permission to see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was lying on his bed wearing the wrap of ʿĀʾishah, and he permitted Abū Bakr while he was in that state, and he dealt with his need with him, then left. Then ʿUmar asked permission, and he permitted him while in that same state, and he dealt with his need with him, then left. ʿUthmān said: Then I asked permission to see him, and he sat up and said to ʿĀʾishah: “Gather your garments around you.” So I dealt with my need with him, then left.
ʿĀʾishah said: O Messenger of Allah, why did I not see you startled for Abū Bakr and ʿUmar as you were startled for ʿUthmān? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “ʿUthmān is a man of modesty, and I feared that if I permitted him in that state, he would not reach me with his need.”
And al-Layth said: And a group of the people said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to ʿĀʾishah: “Should I not feel shy of one before whom the angels feel shy?”
items.ma-515: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ, Ibn Shihāb said: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ informed me that Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ informed him that ʿUthmān and ʿĀʾishah narrated to him: that Abū Bakr asked permission to see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was lying on his bed wearing the wrap of ʿĀʾishah … then he mentioned the meaning of the hadith of ʿUqayl.
items.ma-516: Yūnus narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Abī Ḥabīb, from ʿAbd Allāh – meaning Ibn Abī Salamah – and Nāfiʿ ibn Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim, from Muʿādh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Taymī, from Ḥumrān, the mawlā of ʿUthmān, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever performs ablution and completes the ablution, then walks to an obligatory prayer and prays it, his sin is forgiven him.”
items.ma-517: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh – meaning Ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mawhab – narrated to us, my uncle ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Mawhab informed me, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: ʿUthmān set out for Makkah for Ḥajj, and the wife of Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib came to him, and he spent the night with her until morning. Then he went out in the morning with traces of perfume on him, and a deeply safflower-dyed wrap, and he caught up with the people at Malal before they set out. When ʿUthmān saw him he rebuked him and said “uff,” and said: Do you wear safflower-dyed cloth when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade it? ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib said to him: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not forbid him, nor you; he only forbade me.
items.ma-518: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, my father and Abū Khaythamah narrated to me, both said: Yaʿqūb narrated to us – my father said in his hadith: He said: The son of the brother of Ibn Shihāb informed us; and Abū Khaythamah said: He narrated to me from his uncle – he said: Ṣāliḥ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Farwah informed me that ʿĀmir ibn Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ informed him that he heard Abān ibn ʿUthmān say: ʿUthmān said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Do you see: if at the courtyard of one of you there were a flowing river in which he bathed five times every day, how much of his dirt would remain?” They said: Nothing. He said: “Indeed the prayers take away sins as water takes away dirt.”
items.ma-519: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: I found in my father's book: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Aswad narrated to me, from Ḥuṣayn ibn ʿUmar, from Mukhāriq ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jābir al-Aḥmasī, from Ṭāriq ibn Shihāb, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever deceives the Arabs will not enter into my intercession, and my affection will not reach him.”
items.ma-520: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿAbbās ibn Muḥammad and Abū Yaḥyā al-Bazzāz narrated to me, both said: Ḥajjāj ibn Nuṣayr narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-ʿAwwām ibn Murājim, of Banū Qays ibn Thaʿlabah, from Abū ʿUthmān al-Nahdī, from ʿUthmān, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The hornless one will have retaliation taken for it against the horned one on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-521: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Shaybān ibn Abī Shaybah narrated to us, Mubārak ibn Faḍālah narrated to us, al-Ḥasan narrated to us, he said: I witnessed ʿUthmān command in his khuṭbah the killing of dogs and the slaughtering of doves.
items.ma-522: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿUthmān ibn Abī Shaybah narrated to me, Jarīr narrated to us, from Mughīrah, from Umm Mūsā, she said: ʿUthmān was among the most handsome of people.
items.ma-523: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Suwayd ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from his father, he said: I was praying, and a man passed in front of me, and I tried to stop him but he refused. So I asked ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, and he said: It does not harm you, O son of my brother.
items.ma-524: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Suwayd narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from his father, he said: ʿUthmān said: If you find in the Book of Allah ﷿ that you should place my foot in the shackle, then place it.
items.ma-525: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdah al-Baṣrī narrated to us, al-Mughīrah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥārith al-Makhzūmī narrated to us, my father ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥārith narrated to me, from Zayd ibn ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn, from his father ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Rāfiʿ, the mawlā of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood at ʿArafah with Usāmah ibn Zayd riding behind him, and said: “This is the standing place, and all of ʿArafah is a standing place.” Then he moved on, proceeding at a brisk pace, while the people were striking their mounts to the right and left, and he was turning and saying: “Tranquility, O people! Tranquility, O people!” until he came to al-Muzdalifah, and combined the two prayers. Then he stood at al-Muzdalifah, and stood at Quzaḥ, and had al-Faḍl ibn al-ʿAbbās ride behind him, and said: “This is the standing place, and all of al-Muzdalifah is a standing place.” Then he moved on and proceeded at a brisk pace, while the people were striking their mounts to the right and left, and he was turning and saying: “Tranquility, O people! Tranquility!” … and he mentioned the hadith at its full length.
items.ma-526: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿUthmān ibn Abī Shaybah narrated to me, Yūnus ibn Abī al-Yaʿfūr al-ʿAbdī narrated to us, from his father, from Muslim Abū Saʿīd, the mawlā of ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān: that ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān freed twenty owned slaves, and called for a pair of trousers and tied them on himself – he had never worn them in Jāhiliyyah or Islam – and said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ last night in a dream, and I saw Abū Bakr and ʿUmar, and they said to me: Be patient, for you will break your fast with us the coming night. Then he called for a muṣḥaf and spread it open before him, and he was killed with it before him.
items.ma-527: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr al-Muqaddamī and Abū al-Rabīʿ al-Zahrānī narrated to me, both said: Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from al-Ḥajjāj, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿUthmān, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ablution: he washed his face three times and his hands three times, and washed his forearms three times each, and wiped his head, and washed his feet, washing them thoroughly.
items.ma-528: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq al-Musayyabī narrated to me, Anas ibn ʿIyāḍ narrated to us, from Abū Mawdūd, from Muḥammad ibn Kaʿb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUthmān, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever says: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on the earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing – three times – no sudden calamity of affliction will strike him until night; and whoever says it when he enters the evening, no sudden calamity of affliction will strike him until morning, if Allah wills.
items.ma-529: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, al-Ḥakam ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn Maslamah narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Umayyah, from Mūsā ibn ʿImrān ibn Mannāḥ, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān: that he saw a funeral approaching, and when he saw it he stood, and said: I saw ʿUthmān do that, and he told me that he saw the Prophet ﷺ do it.
items.ma-530: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Abū Ibrāhīm al-Tarjumānī narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Farwah, from Muḥammad ibn Yūsuf, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The morning sleep prevents provision.”
items.ma-531: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Surayj ibn Yūnus narrated to me, Maḥbūb ibn Muḥriz narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Farrūkh, from his father, he said: I witnessed ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān ﵁ being buried in his clothes, with his blood on him, and he was not washed.
items.ma-532: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Abū Yaḥyā al-Bazzāz Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥīm narrated to me, al-Ḥasan ibn Bishr ibn Salm al-Kūfī narrated to us, al-ʿAbbās ibn al-Faḍl al-Anṣārī narrated to us, from Hishām ibn Ziyād al-Qurashī, from his father, from Miḥjan, the mawlā of ʿUthmān, from ʿUthmān, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Allah shades a servant in His shade on the day when there is no shade except His shade: one who gave respite to a person in hardship, or let go of a debt for a debtor.”
items.ma-533: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn ʿUthmān – meaning al-Ḥarbī – Abū Zakariyyā narrated to me, Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from a man whom he named, from Muḥammad ibn Yūsuf, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The morning sleep prevents provision.”
items.ma-534: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Mālik, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The muḥrim does not marry, nor give in marriage, nor propose.”
items.ma-535:
ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr al-Muqaddamī narrated to me, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, Nubayh ibn Wahb narrated to me, he said: ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Maʿmar sent me – he was seeking the daughter of Shaybah ibn ʿUthmān for his son – and he sent to Abān ibn ʿUthmān, who was in charge of the Ḥajj season. He said: Do I not see him as a Bedouin? The muḥrim neither marries nor gives in marriage; ʿUthmān informed me of that from the Prophet ﷺ.
And Nubayh narrated to me, from his father, similarly.
items.ma-536: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr narrated to me, Zuhayr ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Dāwūd ibn Abī Hind narrated to us, from Ziyād ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Umm Hilāl bint Wakīʿ, from Nāʾilah bint al-Furāfiṣah, the wife of ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, she said: The Commander of the Believers ʿUthmān dozed and fell into a light sleep, then woke and said: The people are going to kill me. I said: Never, if Allah wills; it will not reach that; your subjects only asked you to make amends. He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam in my dream, and Abū Bakr and ʿUmar, and they said: You will break your fast with us tonight.
items.ma-537: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Ziyād ibn Ayyūb narrated to me, Hushaym narrated to us, he said: Abū al-Miqdām claimed, from al-Ḥasan ibn Abī al-Ḥasan, he said: I entered the mosque and there was ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān reclining on his cloak, and two water-carriers came to him disputing, and he judged between them. Then I approached him and looked at him: he was a man with a handsome face, with marks of smallpox on his cheek, and his hair had covered his forearms.
items.ma-538: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Umm Ghurāb narrated to me, from Bunānah, she said: ʿUthmān never dyed his hair.
items.ma-539: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Abū ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar al-Qawārīrī narrated to me, Abū al-Qāsim ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, Wāqid ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Tamīmī narrated to me, from one who saw ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān with his teeth fastened with gold.
items.ma-540: Hushaym ibn Bushayr narrated to us by dictation, he said: Muḥammad ibn Qays al-Asadī informed us, from Mūsā ibn Ṭalḥah, he said: I heard ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān on the minbar, while the mu'adhdhin was calling the iqāmah, and he was inquiring of the people, asking them about their news and their prices.
items.ma-541: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Suwayd ibn Saʿīd narrated to me, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from al-Sāʾib ibn Yazīd: that ʿUthmān prostrated in Sūrat Ṣād.
items.ma-542: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Surayj ibn Yūnus narrated to me, Maḥbūb ibn Muḥriz, the seller of glass vessels – a trustworthy Kūfan, so said Surayj – narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbd Allāh – meaning Ibn Farrūkh – from his father, he said: I prayed the ʿīd prayer behind ʿUthmān, and he pronounced the takbīr seven times and five.
items.ma-543: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Sālim Abū Jumayʿ narrated to us, al-Ḥasan narrated to us, and he mentioned ʿUthmān and the intensity of his modesty, and said: He would be in the house with the door closed upon him, and would not take his garment off to pour water over himself, as modesty prevented him from straightening his back.
items.ma-544: Ibrāhīm ibn Khālid al-Ṣanʿānī narrated to us, Umayyah ibn Shibl and others narrated to me, they said: ʿUthmān ruled for twelve years, and the fitnah was five years.
items.ma-545: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā al-Ṭabbāʿ narrated to us, from Abū Maʿshar, he said: ʿUthmān was killed on Friday, eighteen days having passed of Dhū al-Ḥijjah, in the year thirty-five, and his caliphate was twelve years less twelve days.
items.ma-546: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Muʿādh narrated to me, Muʿtamir ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, he said: My father said: Abū ʿUthmān narrated to us: that ʿUthmān was killed in the middle of the days of Tashrīq.
items.ma-547: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Abū Hilāl narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us: that ʿUthmān was killed when he was ninety years old, or eighty-eight.
items.ma-548: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to me, Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Abū Khaldah narrated to us, from Abū al-ʿĀliyah, he said: We were at the door of ʿUthmān, in the ten days of al-Aḍḥā.
items.ma-549: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Qatādah, he said: Al-Zubayr prayed over ʿUthmān and buried him, and he had entrusted his will to him.
items.ma-550: Zakariyyā ibn ʿAdī narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl, he said: ʿUthmān was killed in the year thirty-five, and the fitnah was five years, four months of which belonged to al-Ḥasan ﵁.
items.ma-551: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Abū Khaldah narrated to us, from Abū al-ʿĀliyah, he said: We were at the door of ʿUthmān, in the ten days of al-Aḍḥā.
items.ma-552: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar al-Qawārīrī narrated to me, al-Qāsim ibn al-Ḥakam ibn Aws al-Anṣārī narrated to me, Abū ʿUbādah al-Zuraqī al-Anṣārī, of the people of al-Madīnah, narrated to me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from his father, he said: I witnessed ʿUthmān on the day he was besieged, in the place of funerals, and had a stone been thrown it would have fallen only on a man's head. I saw ʿUthmān look out from the small window that adjoins the station of Jibrīl ﵇, and he said: O people, is Ṭalḥah among you? They fell silent. Then he said: O people, is Ṭalḥah among you? They fell silent. Then he said: O people, is Ṭalḥah among you? They fell silent. Then he said: O people, is Ṭalḥah among you? Then Ṭalḥah ibn ʿUbayd Allāh stood, and ʿUthmān said to him: Do I not see you here? I did not think you would be in a group that heard my call the last of three times and then did not answer me. I adjure you by Allah, O Ṭalḥah, do you remember the day when you and I were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in such-and-such a place, and no one was with him of [[his Companions]] (*) except me and you? He said: Yes. He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to you: “O Ṭalḥah, there is no prophet but that he has with him, of his Companions, a companion from his ummah who is with him in Paradise, and this ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān – meaning me – is my companion with me in Paradise.” Ṭalḥah said: O Allah, yes. Then he left.
items.ma-553: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, al-ʿAbbās ibn al-Walīd al-Narsī narrated to me, Yazīd ibn Zuraymʿ narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Muslim ibn Yasār, from Ḥumrān ibn Abān: that he witnessed ʿUthmān perform ablution one day: he rinsed his mouth and sniffed water into his nose and washed his face three times … and he narrated from the Prophet ﷺ something like the hadith of Ibn Jaʿfar from Saʿīd.
items.ma-554: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Wahb ibn Baqiyyah al-Wāsiṭī narrated to me, Khālid – meaning Ibn ʿAbd Allāh – informed us, from al-Jurayrī, from ʿUrwah ibn Qabīṣah, from a man of the Anṣār, from his father, he said: I was standing by ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, and he said: Shall I not apprise you how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ablution? We said: Yes. So he called for water and washed his face three times, rinsed his mouth and sniffed water into his nose three times, then washed his hands to his elbows three times, then wiped his head and his ears, and washed his feet three times. Then he said: This is how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ablution.
items.ma-555:
ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr ibn ʿAlī al-Muqaddamī narrated to me, Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī narrated to us, Hilāl ibn Ḥiqq narrated to us, from al-Jurayrī, from Thumāmah ibn Ḥazn al-Qushayrī, he said: I witnessed the house on the day ʿUthmān was struck down, and he looked out upon them with one look and said: Call to me your two companions who incited you against me. They were called for him, and he said: I adjure you both by Allah, do you know that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to al-Madīnah the mosque became too narrow for its people, and he said: “Who will buy this plot of land out of his own pure wealth, and be in it like the Muslims, and have better than it in Paradise?” So I bought it out of my own pure wealth and made it among the Muslims, and you prevent me from praying two rakʿahs in it.
Then he said: I adjure you by Allah, do you know that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to al-Madīnah there was no well from which sweet water could be drawn except Rūmah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Who will buy it out of his own pure wealth, so that his bucket in it will be like the buckets of the Muslims, and he will have better than it in Paradise?” So I bought it out of my own pure wealth, and you prevent me from drinking from it.
Then he said: Do you know that I am the man of Jaysh al-ʿUsrah? They said: O Allah, yes.
items.ma-556: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, my father and Abū Khaythamah narrated to me, both said: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Shaqīq, he said: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf met al-Walīd ibn ʿUqbah, and al-Walīd said to him: Why do I see that you have shunned the Commander of the Believers ʿUthmān? ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: Inform him … then he mentioned the hadith, and as for his saying: I stayed behind on the day of Badr, I was tending Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, until she died, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ allotted me a share, and whoever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ allots a share has been present … then he mentioned the hadith at its full length to its end.
items.ma-557: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Sufyān ibn Wakīʿ narrated to me, Qabīṣah narrated to me, from Abū Bakr ibn ʿAyyāsh, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Wāʾil, he said: I said to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf: How did you pledge allegiance to ʿUthmān and leave ʿAlī? He said: What is my fault? I began with ʿAlī, and said: I pledge allegiance to you upon the Book of Allah, the Sunnah of His Messenger, and the way of Abū Bakr and ʿUmar. He said: He said: As far as I am able. He said: Then I presented it to ʿUthmān, and he accepted it.
items.ma-558: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, Zuhrah ibn Maʿbad al-Qurashī narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of ʿUthmān, he said: I heard ʿUthmān say from the minbar: O people, I concealed from you a hadith that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, out of dislike that you would disperse from around me; then it has now occurred to me to narrate it to you, so that a man may choose for himself what appears best to him. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Ribāṭ for a day in the path of Allah is better than a thousand days in any other of the stations.”
items.ma-559: Abū Saʿīd, the mawlā of Banū Hāshim, narrated to us, ʿIkrimah ibn Ibrāhīm, a Bāhilī, narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Dhubāb narrated to us, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-560: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Mūsā ibn Wardān informed us, he said: I heard Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab say: I heard ʿUthmān giving a khuṭbah on the minbar, saying: I used to buy dates from a clan of the Jews called Banū Qaynuqāʿ, and I would sell them for a profit of ṣāʿs. That reached the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: “O ʿUthmān, when you buy, take by measure; and when you sell, measure out.”
items.ma-561: Bishr ibn Shuʿayb ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from al-Zuhrī, ʿUrwah ibn al-Zubayr narrated to me that ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAdī ibn al-Khiyār informed him that ʿUthmān said to him: Indeed Allah sent Muḥammad ﵊ with the truth; I was among those who responded to Allah and His Messenger, and believed in what Muḥammad ﵊ was sent with. Then I emigrated the two emigrations, and I gained the in-law relationship of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. By Allah, I did not disobey him, nor deceive him, until Allah ﷿ took him.
items.ma-562:
Abū Aḥmad Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥārith ibn ʿAyyāsh ibn Abī Rabīʿah, from Zayd ibn ʿAlī, from his father, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Rāfiʿ, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib ﵁, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood at ʿArafah and said: “This is the standing place, and all of ʿArafah is a standing place.” And he moved on when the sun set, then had Usāmah ride behind him, and began to urge his camel on briskly, while the people were striking their mounts to the right and left; he turned to them and said: “Tranquility, O people!” Then he came to Jamʿ and prayed the two prayers with them, Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ, then spent the night until morning, then came to Quzaḥ and stood at Quzaḥ and said: “This is the standing place, and all of Jamʿ is a standing place.” Then he went on until he came to Muḥassir and stopped there, and struck his she-camel, and she trotted until she had crossed the valley, then he held her back. Then he had al-Faḍl ride behind him and went on until he came to the Jamrah and threw at it, then came to the place of slaughter and said: “This is the place of slaughter, and all of Minā is a place of slaughter.”
He said: And a young girl of Khathʿam asked him for a ruling and said: My father is a very old man who has become senile, and the obligation of Allah in Ḥajj has reached him; does it suffice for him if I perform it on his behalf? He said: “Yes, so perform it for your father.” He said: And he had turned al-Faḍl's neck, and al-ʿAbbās said to him: O Messenger of Allah, why did you turn the neck of your cousin? He said: “I saw a young man and a young woman, and I did not feel safe from Shayṭān for the two of them.”
He said: Then a man came to him and said: O Messenger of Allah, I shaved before I slaughtered. He said: “Slaughter, and there is no blame.” Then another came to him and said: O Messenger of Allah, I moved on to the House before I shaved. He said: “Shave or shorten, and there is no blame.”
Then he came to the House and performed ṭawāf around it, then came to Zamzam and said: “O Banū ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, your drinking-service! Were it not that the people would overcome you over it, I would have drawn water with you.”
items.ma-563:
ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn ʿAbd al-Wārith narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Abū Ḥarb ibn Abī al-Aswad, from his father, from ʿAlī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The urine of a boy is sprinkled upon, and the urine of a girl is washed.”
Qatādah said: This is so long as they have not eaten food; when they have eaten, the urine of both is washed.
items.ma-564:
ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdah al-Baṣrī narrated to me, al-Mughīrah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥārith al-Makhzūmī narrated to us, my father ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥārith narrated to me, from Zayd ibn ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, from his father ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Rāfiʿ, the mawlā of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib ﵁: that the Prophet ﷺ stood at ʿArafah with Usāmah ibn Zayd riding behind him, and said: “This is the standing place, and all of ʿArafah is a standing place.” Then he moved on, proceeding at a brisk pace, while the people were striking their mounts to the right and left, and he was turning and saying: “Tranquility, O people! Tranquility, O people!” until he came to al-Muzdalifah, and combined the two prayers. Then he stood at al-Muzdalifah, and stood at Quzaḥ, and had al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbbās ride behind him, and said: “This is the standing place, and all of al-Muzdalifah is a standing place.” Then he moved on and proceeded at a brisk pace, while the people were striking their mounts to the right and left, and he was turning and saying: “Tranquility, tranquility, O people!” until he came to Muḥassir, and struck his mount, and she trotted until he had passed out of it; then he returned to his first pace, until he threw the Jamrah. Then he came to the place of slaughter and said: “This is the place of slaughter, and all of Minā is a place of slaughter.”
Then a young woman of Khathʿam came to him and said: My father is a very old man who has become senile, and the obligation of Allah in Ḥajj has reached him, and he is unable to perform it; will it suffice for him if I perform it on his behalf? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Yes,” and he began turning the face of al-Faḍl ibn al-ʿAbbās away from her.
Then a man came to him and said: I threw the Jamrah, moved on to the House, put on my clothes, and did not shave. He said: “There is no blame; shave.” Then another man came to him and said: I threw, shaved, put on my clothes, and did not slaughter. He said: “There is no blame; slaughter.”
Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ moved on, and called for a bucket of Zamzam water, and drank from it and performed ablution. Then he said: “Draw, O Banū ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib; were it not that you would be overcome over it, I would draw.”
Al-ʿAbbās said: O Messenger of Allah, I saw you turning away the face of your nephew? He said: “I saw a young boy and a young girl, and I feared Shayṭān for the two of them.”
items.ma-565: Abū Saʿīd, the mawlā of Banū Hāshim, narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, from al-Ḥārith, from ʿAlī, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited a protection over a sick person, he would say: “Remove the affliction, Rabb of the people; heal, You are the Healer; there is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no sickness behind.”
items.ma-566: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, from al-Ḥārith, from ʿAlī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If I were to appoint anyone as commander without consultation of the believers, I would appoint Ibn Umm ʿAbd.”
items.ma-567: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn Salamah ibn Abī al-Ḥusām – a Madīnan, mawlā of the family of ʿUmar – narrated to us, Yazīd ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Hād narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Sulaym, from his mother, she said: While we were at Minā, there was ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib ﵁ saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “These are days of eating and drinking, so let no one fast them.” And he followed the people on his camel, crying that out.
items.ma-568: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿAlī ﵁, attributing it to the Prophet, he said: “Whoever lies about his dream will be charged on the Day of Resurrection with tying a barley grain.”
items.ma-569: Abū Saʿīd and Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, both said: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Ḥārith, from ʿAlī, he said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray the two rakʿahs of Fajr at the time of the iqāmah.”
items.ma-570: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Ziyād al-Thaqafī narrated to us, ʿUmārah ibn al-Qaʿqāʿ narrated to us, from al-Ḥārith ibn Yazīd al-ʿUklī, from Abū Zurʿah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Nujayy, he said: ʿAlī said: I had an hour of the pre-dawn in which I would enter upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. If he was standing in prayer, he would say “Subḥān Allāh” to me, and that was his permission to me; and if he was not praying, he gave me permission.
items.ma-571: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn ʿUbayd ibn Abī Karīmah al-Ḥarrānī narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥīm, from Zayd ibn Abī Unaysah, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn, from his father, he said: I heard ʿAlī say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to me while Fāṭimah and I were asleep, and that was at the pre-dawn, until he stood at the door and said: “Will you not pray?” I said in reply to him: O Messenger of Allah, our souls are only in the Yad of Allah, so when He wills to raise us, He raises us. He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went back, and did not return me any word; then I heard him, as he turned away, striking his thigh with his hand and saying: {And man has ever been, most of anything, contentious} [al-Kahf: 54].
items.ma-572: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, from al-Ḥārith, from ʿAlī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his family used to bathe from one vessel.
items.ma-573: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, Simāk narrated to us, from Ḥanash, from ʿAlī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me to Yemen, and we came to a people who had dug a pit for a lion. While they were thus pushing one another, a man fell in and clung to another, then a man clung to another, until there were four of them in it. The lion mauled them, and a man went at it with a spear and killed it, and all of them died of their wounds. The guardians of the first stood up against the guardians of the last, and brought out their weapons to fight one another. ʿAlī ﵁ came to them at that moment and said: Do you want to fight while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is alive? I will judge between you with a judgment; if you accept it, it is the judgment, and if not, some of you will restrain others until you come to the Prophet ﷺ, and he will be the one to judge between you; and whoever transgresses after that has no right. Collect from the tribes of those who were present at the pit a quarter of the blood-money, a third of the blood-money, half of the blood-money, and the full blood-money. The first has the quarter, because those above him perished; the second a third of the blood-money; and the third half of the blood-money. They refused to accept. So they came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was at Maqām Ibrāhīm, and told him the story, and he said: “I will judge between you,” and sat with his arms wrapped around his knees. A man of the people said: ʿAlī has already judged among us. So they told him the story, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ approved it.
items.ma-574: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Simāk informed us, from Ḥanash, that ʿAlī said: And for the fourth, the full blood-money.
items.ma-575: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, he said: Qutaybah ibn Saʿīd wrote to me: I have written to you in my own hand and sealed the letter with my seal; he mentions that al-Layth ibn Saʿd narrated to them, from ʿUqayl, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, that al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī narrated to him from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib: that the Prophet ﷺ came to him and Fāṭimah at night and said: “Will you not pray?” I said: O Messenger of Allah, our souls are only in the Yad of Allah, so when He wills to raise us, He raises us. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ left when I said that to him, then I heard him, as he was turning away, striking his thigh and saying: {And man has ever been, most of anything, contentious}.
items.ma-576: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Naṣr ibn ʿAlī al-Azdī narrated to me, ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī informed me, my brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar narrated to me, from his father Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn, from his father, from his grandfather: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the hand of Ḥasan and Ḥusayn and said: “Whoever loves me, and loves these two, and their father and their mother, will be with me in my rank on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-577: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hubayrah al-Sabaʾī narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurayr al-Ghāfiqī, from ʿAlī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A woman is not to be married alongside her paternal aunt, nor alongside her maternal aunt.”
items.ma-578: Ḥasan and Abū Saʿīd, the mawlā of Banū Hāshim, narrated to us, both said: Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hubayrah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurayr, that he said: I entered upon ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib – Ḥasan said: on the day of al-Aḍḥā – and he brought khazīrah near to us. I said: May Allah set you right, if only you would bring us some of this duck – meaning goose – for Allah ﷿ has made the good plentiful. He said: O Ibn Zurayr, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Nothing of the wealth of Allah is lawful for the caliph except two bowls: a bowl that he eats from, he and his family, and a bowl that he sets before the people.”
items.ma-579: Muʿtamir ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, from his father, from Mughīrah, from Umm Mūsā, from ʿAlī, he said: I have not had sore eyes since the Prophet ﷺ spat in my eye.
items.ma-580: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, Muṭarrif narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿĀṣim, from ʿAlī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray witr in the first part of the night, in the middle of it, and at the end of it; then the witr became fixed for him at the end.
items.ma-581: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Abū Ibrāhīm al-Tarjumānī narrated to me, al-Faraj ibn Faḍālah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from his mother Fāṭimah bint Ḥusayn, from Ḥusayn, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Do not prolong looking at lepers, and when you speak to them, let there be between you and them the length of a spear.”
items.ma-582: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr al-Muqaddamī narrated to me, Hārūn ibn Muslim narrated to us, al-Qāsim ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from his father, from ʿAlī, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said to me: “O ʿAlī, perform the ablution fully even if it is hard on you; do not eat ṣadaqah; do not have donkeys mate with horses; and do not sit with the people of the stars.”
items.ma-583: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Maysarah, from al-Nazzāl ibn Sabrah, he said: A jug of water was brought to ʿAlī ﵁ while he was at al-Raḥbah, and he took a handful of water and rinsed his mouth, sniffed water into his nose, and wiped his face, his forearms and his head. Then he drank while standing. Then he said: This is the ablution of one who has not incurred ḥadath; this is how I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do.
items.ma-584: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ḥabīb, from Thaʿlabah, from ʿAlī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever deliberately lies about me, let him take his seat in the Fire.”
